Provides React charts, treemap renderers, and a network monitoring dashboard.

# Purpose
This code defines a React-based dashboard for network and gossip data and combines several visual components to show peer traffic, message counts, storage statistics, and health status. It uses treemap, pie, table, and bar-style charts to present live or near-live metrics from shared state hooks such as `Je(...)`, `Ds()`, and `Sr(...)`, and it groups related monitoring views into one screen for node or cluster inspection. The file also includes reusable treemap logic in the `rs`, `F0`, and `U0` components, which render the same data model through SVG, HTML, and canvas paths, while `Qr` builds the hierarchy, computes layout, assigns colors, and prepares labels and interaction handlers. The default export `sv` assembles the full dashboard from the table view, health view, traffic treemaps, and storage and message summaries, and it exposes props for data, sizing, colors, labels, animation, and tooltip behavior.
